text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I'm hiking in the mountains
to clear
my head when I hear a familiar
voice from a
nearby suspension bridge.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look, Tachyon! I can see some
edible plants
grow'n on that bank!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well done, Yukino! Let's go
harvest them
right away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a sec! Trainer? Who would've
thought I'd
find you hik'n on the same
mountain!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack, crack, crack! Craaash!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. There goes our way home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the two came here to do
some
foraging. Agnes Tachyon asked
Yukino Bijin to
help her collect
ingredients containing some
special
components.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any signal. Of course, now
that I
know we won't be getting home
any time soon,
I'm starting to feel
peckish. I don't suppose either
of you
have any snacks on you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Stay calm, both of you! Panic'n's just
gonna waste
energy!
choice_data_list: どうしよう、まさかこのまま遭難……？

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Now, I don't have any snacks, but I can
cook us
up someth'n to eat. Just leave it
t'me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I caught a cherry trout! Golly, I'm glad
we found a
river all the way out here!
Now I just gotta throw't
in some bamboo
and cook it up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You sure can! How 'bout you gather
some
firewood?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, would you mind wash'n the
wild veggies
we foraged? We'll cook 'em
up with some
mushrooms once I've
dressed the fish.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm. You do realize mountain vegetables
tend to
be considerably bitter, right? I
don't understand
how you can be so
excited...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! The bitterness will all be
cooked out.
Now come on, start wash'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I just grew up in the mount'ns.
I'm used to
this sorta thing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My grandpa and grandma use t'take me
on walks
and teach me all kinds of
stuff...

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Look, Yukino. This's a silverberry. If
y'ever get
lost in the mountains, y'can
eat these.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
These here're boar tracks. If y'look
close, y'can
even tell which way it went.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gee whiz! You two know everyth'n! ♪
What about
this plant? Can I eat it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to them that I know so much
about the
mountains! So just relax 'n'
leave all this t'me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wh-what was that noise?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A deer? A boar? Or... maybe a bear?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Us Umamusume should be able to
run away
if it comes to it, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You two, get behind me. Don't make any
sudden
movements... Just start slowly
back'n away...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If it comes down to it, I'll kick it in the
nose. Then,
Tachyon, I want you t'put
Trainer on your back
and run like the
wind.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Hiker A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I knew I smelled something good!
Hey, this
is a pretty advanced trail, so
that must mean
you're all seasoned
hikers!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cheese and crackers, mister! I thought
you were a
bear!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cheese and crackers, mister! I thought
you were a
bear!
choice_data_list: いや、守ってくれてありがとう

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew... Nnngh!
choice_data_list: いや、守ってくれてありがとう

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That scared the heebie-jeebies outta
meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may have looked calm, but how could you not be afraid of a bear? It must've taken everything she had to hide her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, all right. Pull yourself together.
It's
difficult to tell whether you're
actually strong or
weak!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah! I was so scaaared! I'm just glad I
get t'see
'nother day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
C-c'mon now, there wasn't anyth'n to be
scared of
in the first place, r'member?
Turns out we weren't
stranded, and that
"bear" was just a fellow hiker.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. It's an undeniable fact that
your
presence put us at ease and
allowed us to act
calmly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
R-really? Well, I'm pleased as punch
that I could
help.
choice_data_list: おかげで落ち着いて行動できた

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well then, let's enjoy this soup
and then
head home! I'm so glad we're
all okay!
